subject.title: Feature Request: Add Skill Priority Configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class user-configurable skill priority contract now, or fold this into a broader skill preferences/smart-indexing design?
rationale: The request adds new config and CLI surface in the agent skill-selection path, and repository policy treats config/default additions and optional skill capability direction as maintainer-owned product/API decisions.

options.title: Design canonical priority contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify how priority interacts with source precedence, per-agent allowlists, prompt truncation, and future smart indexing before implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader skill preferences
options.body: Close or mark this as tracked by a broader preferences/indexing item if maintainers want one unified user-convention and selection contract.

options.title: Reject core priority surface
options.body: Decline core priority config and keep selection controlled by skill descriptions, source precedence, and external ClawHub/bundle packaging.

recommendation.title: Design canonical priority contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify how priority interacts with source precedence, per-agent allowlists, prompt truncation, and future smart indexing before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest verified recent history across the skill config and CLI surfaces that this decision would change.
